purpose: Candidate sources for comparing smaller language-specific IndicConformer models with the existing shared multilingual Veena model. Not a production model catalogue.

validation.community_metadata: All 22 ONNX entries, sizes and expected SHA256 values were read from the pinned Hugging Face API. Model SHA256 values are publisher metadata, not local content verification.
validation.official_downloads: Anonymous HEAD requests returned HTTP 200 and Content-Length 523192320 for all 22 publisher-linked .nemo URLs. Payload identity has not been verified.
validation.shared_tokens: Downloaded at the pinned revision and SHA256 computed locally.
validation.model_execution: This catalogue does not assert runtime, accuracy, browser compatibility or performance validation. Independent benchmark reports are required.

official.download_access: Official objectstore links are publicly accessible; official Hugging Face model repositories require acceptance of access conditions.

community.license_note: The repository-level metadata is Apache-2.0 and includes other model families. Its model card identifies the IndicConformer source weights as MIT; preserve applicable upstream notices.
community.quantization_recipe: ONNX Runtime quant_pre_process, then dynamic QUInt8 per-channel quantization of MatMul only; convolution weights remain floating point.
community.format: ONNX CTC, opset 16, language mask baked into output, global aggregate vocabulary

community_fp32.format: Unquantized ONNX CTC community export; intended as an optional source for fresh quantization, subject to interface and quality validation.
community_fp32.license_note: This export repository declares CC-BY-4.0. Keep that source attribution and license separate from the MIT-labelled official and parismitaglobalsolutions artifacts.

as.reason: Only README.md and .gitattributes present; no model weights.

openvoiceos.format: Language-specific ONNX FP32 with external data, or single-file INT8; Telugu graph verified to use own local 257-class vocabulary. Other models remain uninspected locally.

selection_notes: Download only chosen language packs when minimizing per-user storage; all 22 separate models use substantially more aggregate disk space than the single shared multilingual model.
Do not treat smaller file size as a speed guarantee; measure preprocessing, session load, warmed inference, peak memory and language-wise WER/CER on target hardware.
The community card does not supply a comprehensive all-22-language WER or target-device latency evaluation; its notebook acknowledges possible utterance-start differences from Sherpa preprocessing.

The current 600M multilingual model remains the all-language shared baseline. No smaller officially released shared all-22 checkpoint was identified in the AI4Bharat model inventory during this review.
Quantization validation must use held-out speech in each language. A single Telugu transcript or random-feature smoke test is insufficient for a production claim.

OpenVoiceOS publishes additional FP32 ONNX graphs plus external weights and smaller INT8 candidates for 21 languages; its Assamese repository contains no weights. Together with the existing sulabhkatiyar Assamese source, FP32 exports are available for all 22 languages. The OpenVoiceOS Telugu graph has 257 output classes and local blank 256; validate its runtime contract separately from the existing 5633-class graph.

community_fp32_decoder.tokenizer_verification: All 5632 source vocabulary strings exactly match the published shared community tokens; Assamese indices verified from the downloaded community Assamese graph additive mask.
